faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Birla Institute of Technology & Science Pilani (BITS Pilani) for a project-based research position in Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under a DRDO-sponsored project within the computer science and allied engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position offered through this specific recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a first-class B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, or allied disciplines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years, with permissible age relaxations applicable for SC, ST, PwD, and OBC candidates as per guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What salary or stipend is offered for the selected candidate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- as Junior Research Fellow, specifically for NET or GATE qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 30-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their submissions reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for BITS Pilani JRF Recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively via email by sending the required documents to the designated email address provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of candidates based on their merit and experience, followed by an online interview for shortlisted applicants.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application email be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be emailed to [email protected] with the subject line clearly specified as 'Application for JRF -DRDO Project'.
